convergence.interpretation: OSW numerical convergence gates, not physical measurement uncertainty.

source_case_association: NOAA mission prose names the northeastern surveyed feature Haskell. Recovered TOPEX/ERS-2 August 1 1999 chart supplies plotted waypoint 6 as a manual survey proxy at 87.0 W, 28.3 N, not a measured eddy center. The August 3 mission, nominal August 1 chart, daily numerical product and May registry separation remain distinct definitions.
method_interpretation: Unchanged frozen native-ADT speed-contour method. A unique maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects a core contour; its area, equivalent radius and bounding arcs do not describe the full outer eddy.

rounding_rule.meaning: Fixed outward reporting of two numerical level-step results, not physical uncertainty or annual extrema.

limitations: Survey waypoint proxy, not an observed center; no reported position error. Archived chart dated August 1, August 3 mission naming and registry May separation remain separate. No field-inspected seed adjustment.

Source point/grid peak distance and 150 km search radius are not positional accuracy. Native 0.125 degree sampling and minimum 12 interior gridpoints are not effective resolution. Mapping, MDT, derivative, interpolation and physical-front errors are unquantified.
One dated snapshot, not an annual cycle, physical uncertainty, outer boundary, principal width, material footprint, verified identity, state intersection, ranking, volume or playback.
